sources.snippet: Experimental Research Preview Klyra-Decision-16M-Choice-V3 is an experimental AI decision model developed by Polyvor Labs as part of the Klyra research initiative. This release focuses on improving structured decision-making, option selection, and generalization across different inputs.

sources.title: Jahirrrr/Klyra-64M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Klyra-64M Klyra-64M is a compact language model family developed as an academic research project. The project was initiated and developed by students of Informatics Engineering at Politeknik Negeri Jakarta (State Polytechnic of Jakarta), with a focus on efficient language modeling, staged post-training, reasoning, reinforcement learning, and model distillation at the sub-100M parameter scale.
